summary: This bill directs the U.S. Treasury Secretary to advocate for the removal of prohibitions on nuclear energy financing at international financial institutions and to establish Nuclear Energy Assistance Trust Funds to support nuclear energy generation and distribution in borrowing countries.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to establish Nuclear Energy Assistance Trust Funds within international financial institutions and advocate for the removal of prohibitions against financial and technical assistance for nuclear energy. This directly involves increasing financial and technical assistance to other countries for nuclear energy development, which falls under the umbrella of foreign aid.
